description: Renovate config: weekly grouped updates, automerged dev-dep minors (CI gates them), majors held for review.

packageRules.description: Next.js and its ESLint config are version-synced upstream
React and its type packages move together
Tailwind core and the PostCSS plugin move together
The markdown pipeline packages are released in lockstep
Playwright minors ship new browser builds; keep them in one PR
CI (typecheck, unit, e2e, Lighthouse) gates these; automerge safe non-majors
zod major is blocked: src/lib uses the v3 API from 'zod' while src/generation deliberately imports 'zod/v4' for the Anthropic SDK — see AGENTS.md before upgrading
@types/node majors follow the Node runtime (pinned to 22 in CI and Cloudflare), not the newest release
